actions.reason: Inspect the visible workspace contents to find any existing launcher or configuration artifacts.
Inspect the only visible image-related file metadata if needed after workspace listing.

success_contract.objective: Run Windows 3.11 for Workgroups from /app/isos/win311.img in QEMU with immutable snapshot mode, VNC on :1 (port 5901), nginx web access on port 80, and programmatic keyboard input support, leaving the VM running in the background at the Windows 3.11 desktop.
required_artifacts: A running QEMU process launched against /app/isos/win311.img
A VNC listener on 127.0.0.1:5901 or equivalent :1 binding
An nginx listener on port 80 serving a web interface for remote access
A QEMU launch configuration or wrapper that enables snapshot mode and programmatic keyboard input
required_behaviors: QEMU starts successfully and remains running in the background
The VM reaches the Windows 3.11 desktop state
VNC display :1 is accessible for monitoring
QEMU is configured so keyboard input can be injected programmatically beyond manual VNC interaction
The base disk image is not modified because QEMU runs in snapshot mode
known_invalid_patterns: File existence without a running VM
A QEMU command that does not actually start or remain running
VNC or nginx configuration that is present but not listening
Manual-only keyboard control without a programmatic input path
Checks that only prove binaries exist or commands parse
verification_plan: Inspect workspace for existing launch scripts or configs
Start or adapt QEMU with snapshot mode, VNC :1, and a keyboard-control channel
Start nginx on port 80 with a simple web interface if needed
Use QEMU monitor or another external control path to demonstrate programmatic keyboard input capability
Confirm the VM is at the Windows 3.11 desktop via VNC or logs
finalization_evidence_required: Receipt-backed evidence of the QEMU launch command and running process
Receipt-backed evidence of VNC listening on port 5901
Receipt-backed evidence of nginx listening on port 80
Receipt-backed evidence of a programmatic keyboard input path being configured or exercised
Receipt-backed evidence that the VM reached the Windows 3.11 desktop or equivalent boot-complete state
